info.title: Buggcraft Resource Translation API
info.description: Implemented Buggcraft resource translation protocol. Project entities only; title passthrough, summary/body machine translation. See /docs for operational limits.

get.summary: Discover providers, hashes, profiles and generation availability

post.summary: Read exact-hash translations in one batch; no generation or source fetch

parameters.name: X-Client-Id
parameters.description: Public application identifier, never an authentication secret.

post.summary: Verify source hashes and request deduplicated background generation
post.description: Requires translations:ensure authorization, including a short-lived anonymous generation session. No developer secret in launchers. Idempotency keys are principal-scoped, retained 24 hours, and return 409 for a different body. Deferred fields are explicit and never claim generation is running.

200.description: Latest known verified source, not a live source fetch

get.summary: Subscribe to ticket notifications over SSE
get.description: Maximum 50 distinct caller-owned ticket IDs. Heartbeat about every 20 seconds. Retain event cursors for 24 hours; send reset when the cursor expired. Use authenticated fetch streaming or same-site secure cookies, never a URL token. Disable proxy buffering. SSE connection counts have a separate quota. Event payload schema is given in x-event-schema.

200.description: SSE frames with id, event, data. Data is a JSON Event; heartbeats are SSE comments.

post.summary: Issue a short-lived anonymous generation session
post.description: client_id is public. Enforce origin IP issuance rate, per-session generation limits and global spend before issuing/using tokens. Do not trust forwarded IP headers except from configured proxies. No-store response; do not log token bodies.

201.description: Short-lived caller session; token validity at most one hour

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous response, 50 records per page.

BearerAuth.description: Short-lived anonymous token from POST /v1/sessions/anonymous; admin endpoints require the separately configured server admin token.

ClientKey.description: Approved developer key prefixed bct_. Reuse for ensure/jobs/events/feedback. Public reads remain anonymous. Never embed a privileged server key in distributed launchers; use your backend or individual user credentials.

AdminToken.description: Private server administrator token. Never distribute to clients.

AdminSessionCookie.name: translation_admin
AdminSessionCookie.description: Short-lived HttpOnly browser session established after administrator-token login.

ResourceRef.description: Stable upstream identity. For project entities entity_id must equal project_id. Provider must appear in capabilities. Author and creation date are not part of the primary key.

IdentityHint.description: Untrusted corroboration only; ownership changes never change the resource identity.

LookupItem.description: No arbitrary source text. request_id values must be unique within a batch and fields unique within an item. snapshot_hash is optional and valid only for a complete source entity.

ResolveRequest.description: Read-only lookup, maximum 64 KiB. No source fetch or generation is started. Batch POST is not automatically CDN cacheable.

EnsureRequest.description: Request verified generation without uploading arbitrary text. Priority is server controlled; at most 64 KiB.

Translation.description: For body fields prefer an artifact reference, avoiding large inline batch responses. Only safe validated content is published.

Segment.description: Only ready segments include validated translated text. An incomplete document must not be represented as a complete ready translation.

FieldResult.description: ready requires an exact verified match to requested_source_hash; it may describe a historical source (is_current=false). current_source_hash is the latest verified source, not an absolute upstream freshness guarantee. Stale fallback is allowed only when explicitly requested and is never placed in translation for a different source hash.

requested_source_hash.description: For internal source refresh jobs this is an opaque coalescing hash, not a field source hash.

Ticket.description: Caller-owned request ticket, internally attached to deduplicated generation. Reading it requires the owning principal/session. Source mismatch never changes the requested hash into a verified source.

Manifest.description: Only checked data, never a synchronous upstream fetch. Unknown body must not be hashed as empty; fields_complete=false implies snapshot_hash=null. Field translation states are evaluated for requested language/profile.

Artifact.description: Published complete output, encoded as JCS UTF-8 JSON bytes. SHA-256 of exactly those bytes equals the digest in the URL. The artifact contains no self-hash field. Current selection and revocation are checked through manifests; historical bytes remain immutable.

Event.description: Notification only. Re-resolve or read ticket state after each relevant event. Events are scoped to authenticated ticket subscriptions; reset means retained cursor expired.

AnonymousSessionRequest.description: Application identification only. Cannot grant special privileges or bypass IP/global budget limits. No fingerprint, upstream key or arbitrary prompt is accepted.

AnonymousSession.description: Opaque short-lived session; keep in memory, never put in query strings. Suggested scopes are translations:ensure, jobs:read and feedback:write. Issuance and generation have independent quotas.

ProjectSummary.description: translation_state aggregates summary and body; ready requires both to match current source, language, context and policy. field_states contains individual readiness. localized_summary alone does not imply body readiness.

HistoryEntry.description: Public audit metadata only. observed_at is when the platform learned the event, not a promise of the exact upstream edit time.

website.description: Optional project homepage; HTTP URLs and other public homepage formats are accepted.

model_prices.description: USD per one million tokens, keyed by exact upstream model id. Cached input is priced separately. Prices are snapshotted per call; omitting a model price makes its cost unknown.

access_token.description: Shown once. Store safely. Pending credentials cannot generate; active after approval.

NotFound.description: Not found or unavailable to this principal

Conflict.description: Idempotency key reused with a different body, or expired pagination cursor; inspect error code.

Invalid.description: Invalid field, resource, hash, profile or batch
